snippet.title: WW Final Trailer EN 4K
snippet.description:
An unknown signal. A silent ship.
Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened - and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

Final Trailer for White Whisper
